Q: iOS PDF Kit PDF Compression not reducing PDF Size A:

I fixed it by making scale less than 1 . Example: use scale = 0.7 for 70% scale as compared to the original

Update: Better solution is to implement "Good Flattening Technique" for flattening PDF. Compression is not needed after that

Q: Raspberry Pi shows "HDMI no signal" when TV and Pi power on simultaneously, but works if TV is already on A:

By default the raspberry detects the HDMI connected TV only at boot time. But if you power on both at the same time, TV and Raspberry start booting at the same time. At boot time the Raspberry can not yet recognize the TV as the TV has not yet finished booting. Then the raspberry disables the HDMI port until the next boot.

AFAIR you can force your Raspberry to enable HDMI by an entry in the config.txt in the boot partition.
